latest_release.name: Release 26.9.4-2
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Test that conda init works on windows by @isuruf in https://github.com/conda-forge/miniforge/pull/916
* Run offline tests as soon as the build test passes by @isuruf in https://github.com/conda-forge/miniforge/pull/917
* Bump the github-actions group with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/conda-forge/miniforge/pull/918
* Add Windows ARM64 installer builds and tests by @ClayWarren in https://github.com/conda-forge/miniforge/pull/903

## New Contributors
* @ClayWarren made their first contribution in https://github.com/conda-forge/miniforge/pull/903

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/conda-forge/miniforge/compare/26.9.4-1...26.9.4-2
